name: section-rail
title: Section Rail
summary: A compact navigation rail that tracks progress through a long page and reveals labels or editorial context.
useWhen: A long page, case study, or multi-step flow needs compact section navigation.
Readers benefit from seeing the active section and nearby context.
avoidWhen: The page is too short to need persistent section navigation.
The destinations lead to separate pages rather than sections in one experience.
accessibility: Uses anchor links in scroll mode and buttons with current-state semantics in controlled mode.
Shows visible labels for coarse pointers instead of relying on hover-only targets.

motion.purpose: Connect the active indicator and contextual details to the reader's current section.
motion.reducedMotion: Simplify indicator transitions and scrolling while preserving active-section feedback.
